item.title: Manfrotto ONE Photo: a stills photography tripod for the ONE platform
item.description: Manfrotto has added a stills-first model to its ONE tripod range, with a non-round leg profile, simultaneous leg deployment, and Q90 column positioning.

item.title: Adobe Photoshop AI Assistant public beta: Firefly Image Editor updated with new tools
item.description: Adobe's AI Assistant for Photoshop moves to public beta, while Firefly gets a unified image editing workspace and expanded third-party model support across both platforms.

item.title: Sonos Play and Era 100 SL: new speakers for 2026
item.description: Sonos has unveiled two new speakers, the Sonos Play and Era 100 SL, both aimed squarely at making it easier to build and expand a whole-home audio setup, while the Play lets you carry that outside.

item.title: 7Artisans PL Mount Adapter Kit: Cinema lenses on mirrorless for $179
item.description: 7Artisans' new PL Lens Adapter Kit brings cinema glass to Sony E, Nikon Z, Canon RF, and L-Mount mirrorless cameras for $179 all-in.

item.title: Manchester Creator Connect 2026 | Free Filmmaking Event
item.description: RedShark is proud to be supporting Manchester Creator Connect, an exclusive free event we've helped put together for filmmakers, colourists, editors, and content creators who want to get hands-on with the future of HDR workflows.

item.title: YoloLiv 18 mm F1.4 MFT lens launched for YoloCam S7
item.description: YoloLiv has announced its first lens: an 18 mm F1.4 prime for the Micro Four Thirds mount, designed specifically for use with its YoloCam S7 live streaming camera.

item.title: Accsoon releases CineView M7 Pro Triple-Monitor Kit for multicamera vertical capture
item.description: Accsoon's CineView M7 Pro Triple-Monitor Kit puts three wireless 7-in monitors in one V-mount-powered cage, making it a practical solution for multi-camera and vertical capture workflows.

item.title: Marshall Electronics CV574-WP: a 4K all-weather NDI POV camera for IP workflows
item.description: Marshall Electronics is making its debut in the all-IP camera space with the CV574-WP, a weatherproof 4K POV camera built around NDI|HX3.

item.title: Sony Camera Authenticity Solution adds video verification
item.description: The latest Camera Authenticity Solution ver.2026.1 software update expands Sony's C2PA compliant verification technology to include video in beta.

item.title: How the cameras behind this year's Oscar nominees prove film is back
item.description: From IMAX 65mm to a one-of-a-kind VistaVision camera, the 98th Academy Awards nominees reveal a striking return to film.
